scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs chrome && TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build --mode relay && node scripts/prune-dist.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs firefox && TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build --mode relay && node scripts/postprocess-firefox.mjs && node scripts/prune-dist.mjs firefox
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify:build && node scripts/prune-dist.mjs chrome && node scripts/prune-dist.mjs firefox && node node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js lint --source-dir dist/firefox --self-hosted && node scripts/prune-dist.mjs firefox
